about.description:
The Ham Radio Control Library (Hamlib, for short) is a project to provide programs with a consistent Application Programming Interface (API) for controlling the myriad of radios and rotators available to amateur radio and communications users. Many Amateur Radio Transceivers come with serial interfaces that allows software to control the radio. This project will endeavour to provide shared libraries that greatly simplify the application programmer's interaction with radio equipment and other controllable devices such as rotators, switches, etc.
The Hamlib Wiki Supported Radios page, https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/wiki/Supported-Radios, contains a snapshot of the supported radios at the time of the last Hamlib release.
about.summary: Ham radio control library for rigs, rotators, tuners, and amplifiers

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "4.7.2"
  soversion: "${{ (version | split('.'))[0] }}"
  build: 1
  posix: ${{ "m2-" if win else "" }}

recipe:
  name: hamlib-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/Hamlib/Hamlib/releases/download/${{ version }}/hamlib-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ae1fcf2dbc80ea0786ea8f047b09399c3f7737d1930442f61a031708ed33e88f
  patches:
    - 0001-Install-perl-bindings-to-vendor-location.patch
    - 0002-Fix-tcl-binding-output-name-on-macOS-end-in-.dylib.patch
    - 0003-Add-include-guards-to-hamlib-config.h.patch
    - 0004-Fix-binding-compilation-on-Windows.patch
    - 0005-Add-missing-stdlib.h-include-needed-after-libxml2-2..patch
    - 0006-Add-missing-misc.h-include-remove-incorrectly-and-st.patch
    - 0007-memsave-Fix-reference-to-mem_caps-tag-which-is-an-un.patch
    - 0008-Change-RCCOMPILE-to-not-include-CPPFLAGS.patch
    - 0009-Allow-lua-versions-up-to-6.0.patch
    - 0010-Add-missing-ctype.h-to-define-tolower-used-in-tests-.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build }}

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: hamlib-build
    requirements:
      build:
        # need default compiler on Windows too (MSVC) for generating import lib
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - if: win
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_cxx") }}
        - ${{ posix }}autoconf
        - if: unix
          then: ${{ posix }}automake
        - if: win
          then:
            - ${{ posix }}automake-wrapper
            - ${{ posix }}base
        - gnuconfig
        - ${{ posix }}libtool
        - ${{ posix }}make
        # perl is run during build, so it needs to be a build dep,
        # but also we need the version to be pinned so it matches the host
        - if: not win and build_platform == target_platform
          then: perl
        - pkg-config
        - ${{ posix }}sed
        # SWIG 4.5.0 dropped the Python 2 -> 3 compatibility shims that Hamlib's
        # generated bindings rely on, causing mismatched declaration
        # errors. Pin below 4.5 until upstream Hamlib supports SWIG 4.5.
        - swig <4.5
        # cross-compilation requirements
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - libpython
            - lua
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
      host:
        - libpython
        - libusb
        - libxml2-devel
        - lua
        - if: not win and build_platform == target_platform
          then: perl
        - python
        - if: unix
          then: readline
        # this is the tcl dependency
        # If tk pin ever moves into version 9, will need to migrate to
        # split packaging (i.e. libtcl-devel)
        - tk
        # pkgconfig link dep of libxml2, not actually linked against
        - zlib *

  - package:
      name: libhamlib${{ soversion }}
    inherit:
      from: hamlib-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - if: linux
          then:
            - lib/libhamlib.so.${{ soversion }}*
            - lib/libhamlib++.so.${{ soversion }}*
        - if: osx
          then:
            - lib/libhamlib.${{ soversion }}*.dylib
            - lib/libhamlib++.${{ soversion }}*.dylib
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/libhamlib-${{ soversion }}*.dll
            - Library/bin/libhamlib++-${{ soversion }}*.dll
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: not win
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
            - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
          else:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_cxx") }}
      host:
        - libusb
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          files:
            - if: linux
              then:
                - lib/libhamlib.so.${{ soversion }}*
                - lib/libhamlib++.so.${{ soversion }}*
            - if: osx
              then:
                - lib/libhamlib.${{ soversion }}*.dylib
                - lib/libhamlib++.${{ soversion }}*.dylib
            - if: win
              then:
                - Library/bin/libhamlib-${{ soversion }}*.dll
                - Library/bin/libhamlib++-${{ soversion }}*.dll

  - package:
      name: hamlib
    inherit:
      from: hamlib-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}bin/**
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}include/hamlib/**
        - if: linux
          then:
            - lib/libhamlib.so
            - lib/libhamlib++.so
        - if: osx
          then:
            - lib/libhamlib.dylib
            - lib/libhamlib++.dylib
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/lib/hamlib.lib
            - Library/lib/hamlib++.lib
            - Library/lib/libhamlib.dll.a
            - Library/lib/libhamlib++.dll.a
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/pkgconfig/hamlib.pc
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: not win
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
          else:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, exact=True) }}
        - libusb
        - libxml2-devel
        - if: unix
          then: readline
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, upper_bound=None) }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          bin:
            - ampctl
            - ampctld
            - rigctl
            - rigctlcom
            - rigctld
            - rigctlsync
            - rigctltcp
            - rigmem
            - rigsmtr
            - rigswr
            - rigtestlibusb
            - rigtestmcast
            - rigtestmcastrx
            - rotctl
            - rotctld
          include:
            - hamlib/rig.h
            - hamlib/*
          lib:
            - if: not win
              then:
                - hamlib
                - hamlib++
          files:
            - if: win
              then:
                - Library/lib/hamlib.lib
                - Library/lib/hamlib++.lib
                - Library/lib/libhamlib.dll.a
                - Library/lib/libhamlib++.dll.a
            - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/pkgconfig/hamlib.pc
      - script:
          - ampctl --help
          - ampctld --help
          - rigctl --help
          - rigctlcom --help
          - rigctld --help
          - rigmem --help
          - rigsmtr --help
          - rigswr --help
          - rotctl --help
          - rotctld --help

  - package:
      name: hamlib-lua
    inherit:
      from: hamlib-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/lua/*/Hamliblua*
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: not win
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
          else:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, exact=True) }}
        - lua
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, upper_bound=None) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - lua -e "require('Hamliblua')"

  - package:
      name: hamlib-perl
    inherit:
      from: hamlib-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      skip: win or (build_platform != target_platform)
      files:
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/perl*/**/Hamlib.*
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: not win
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
          else:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, exact=True) }}
        - perl
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, exact=True) }}
        - perl
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, upper_bound=None) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - perl -e "use Hamlib"

  - package:
      name: hamlib-python
    inherit:
      from: hamlib-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - ${{ "Lib/" if (win and match(python, "<3.15")) else "lib/python*" }}site-packages/*Hamlib*
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: not win
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
          else:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
        # conda-build needs native python to make .pyc files
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, exact=True) }}
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, exact=True) }}
        - python
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, upper_bound=None) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - Hamlib
          pip_check: false

  - package:
      name: hamlib-tcl
    inherit:
      from: hamlib-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - ${{ "Library/" if win }}lib/tcl*/Hamlib/*
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: not win
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
          else:
            - ${{ compiler("m2w64_c") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, exact=True) }}
        - tk
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, upper_bound=None) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - echo "package require hamlib" | tclsh
          - echo "exit [catch {package require hamlib}]" | tclsh

  - package:
      name: hamlib-all
    build:
      string: ${{ "osx" if osx else "linux" if linux else "win" if win }}_${{ build }}
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - if: linux
          then: __linux
        - if: osx
          then: __osx
        - if: win
          then: __win
        - hamlib ${{ version }}.*
        - hamlib-lua ${{ version }}.*
        - if: not win and not osx
          then: hamlib-perl ${{ version }}.*
        - hamlib-python ${{ version }}.*
        - hamlib-tcl ${{ version }}.*
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libhamlib" + soversion, upper_bound=None) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - Hamlib
          pip_check: false
